phases.name: Phase 01 — Walking Skeleton (US-U1..U6 vertical slice)
phases.description: Minimum end-to-end slice that unignores us_u1_walking_skeleton::devon_reclaims_disk_by_unifying_a_duplicated_model_from_the_main_view. Builds the core types, AppState refactor, summary-bar wiring, dedup-glyph computation, hash pool scaffold, u-from-main-view dispatch, and post-unify reclassification. Each step is atomic; the LAST step removes #[ignore] after all foundational infra is in place.

steps.name: Add core dedup-glyph and synthetic-slot domain types
steps.description: Create the new pure data types in modeltap-core: DedupGlyph enum, SyntheticSlot enum, LeftPaneSlot enum, DedupSummary struct. Type-only step; no behavior, no I/O. Lays the foundation for every later step.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: (no Gherkin scenario yet — pure type addition; first behavioral consumer is step 01-04)
steps.implementation_notes: Pure data only. Add #[derive(Debug, Clone, Eq, PartialEq, Hash, serde::Serialize)] per data-models.md. Place in new modules domain::dedup_glyph and domain::synthetic_slot. Re-export at crate root. UnifiedRow struct also defined here. NO logic yet — that lands in 01-02.

steps.name: Implement compute_dedup_glyph and dedup_summary pure functions
steps.description: Add core::logic::dedup::compute_dedup_glyph(target, inventory, in_progress, failed) -> DedupGlyph and core::logic::dedup::dedup_summary(inventory, hashing_done) -> DedupSummary. Pure functions, fully unit-tested. Glyph derivation table in architecture-design.md §6.2 is the contract.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: A dedup-able model shows the "=" glyph in the right pane
quality_gates: unit tests cover all 6 DedupGlyph variants + Failed sentinel
steps.implementation_notes: Inputs are passed in (no re-stat). The inode-equality test distinguishes = from #. Use existing PlanCandidate's (device, inode) data; do NOT re-stat in classifier. Conservative-when-uncertain (BR-3): hash failure -> Unique with sentinel. Add unit tests in modeltap-core/tests/dedup_glyph_test.rs covering Pending, Hashing, Unique, DedupAble, AlreadyUnified, Failed.

steps.name: Refactor AppState.tools to AppState.left_pane_slots
steps.description: Mechanical refactor of AppState per ADR-014: replace tools: Vec<ToolView> with left_pane_slots: Vec<LeftPaneSlot>. Add hash_state: HashPoolState, dedup_summary: DedupSummary, summary_delta: Option<SummaryDelta> fields. Selection navigation continues to operate on length unchanged. All v1 tests must continue passing.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: The "[All Unified]" slot appears below the real tool slots in the left pane
quality_gates: every v1 acceptance test (us_01..us_20, us_05b, us_atomic_chat_discovery) continues to pass
steps.implementation_notes: Per ADR-014: synthetic slot does NOT round-trip through Box<dyn Tool>. Only LeftPaneSlot::Real arms invoke action orchestrators. Existing tests that hardcode tools[0] indices need to access LeftPaneSlot::Real(...) destructure. Synthetic slot sorts last (real tools first). HashPoolState/SummaryDelta types live in modeltap-tui app_state module per data-models.md.

steps.name: Wire summary_bar to dedup_summary; remove hardcoded "0 B" literal
steps.description: Fix the v1 bug at crates/modeltap-tui/src/render/summary_bar.rs:36. Read from state.dedup_summary.dedup_able_bytes. When state.hash_state.is_hashing() is true, render "Dedup-able: computing...". When dedup_summary is None or hashing not yet started, also render computing. Final value rendered when hashing complete.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Summary bar shows "computing..." while any hash is pending
quality_gates: grep -n 'Dedup-able: 0 B' summary_bar.rs returns no string-literal match
steps.implementation_notes: Single source of truth (NFR-5): the bar reads dedup_summary, NOT a separate computation. Use AppState.hash_state.is_hashing() / is_complete() to choose render branch. Test snapshot: TestBackend with state where hashing_done=false -> 'computing...'; hashing_done=true with empty inventory -> '0 B'.

steps.name: Add dedup-glyph column to render::row
steps.description: Insert a new fixed-width dedup-glyph column (1 char + 1 space) between the existing compatibility-glyph column and the size column. Reads DedupGlyph from per-row data computed via core::logic::dedup::compute_dedup_glyph during render-data assembly. The existing RowIndicator (o/*/!/?) compatibility column stays untouched.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: A dedup-able model shows the "=" glyph in the right pane
quality_gates: snapshot tests for all 5 glyphs (?/~/-/=/#) plus Failed (-!) decorator
steps.implementation_notes: Color: = and # benefit from accent color BUT must be distinguishable by glyph alone (NFR-6, NO_COLOR respect). Two enums (RowIndicator + DedupGlyph) avoid one overloaded enum. Per-row glyph is computed in render-data assembly path, not in render::row itself (purity).

steps.name: Add hash pool Msg variants and pure update handlers
steps.description: Add Msg::HashComputed, Msg::HashFailed, Msg::HashProgressTick, Msg::UnifyApplied, Msg::SummaryDeltaExpired, Msg::UnifyHighlighted to the existing Msg enum. Implement pure update::handle_hash handlers that increment counters in HashPoolState and re-classify affected rows by calling core::logic::dedup pure functions.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: A model currently being hashed shows the "~" glyph
quality_gates: unit tests for each Msg variant verifying pure state transition
steps.implementation_notes: Pure handlers — no I/O, no async. Each handler takes (state, msg) -> state. HashFailureReason enum lives next to Msg. UnifyOutcome carried on Msg::UnifyApplied is the existing actions::unify::run output. Reclassification on HashComputed should be scoped to the affected dedup-key (perf), but full-pass is acceptable for v1.

steps.name: Implement modeltap-app::hash_pool module (workers + queue + cancellation)
steps.description: Create the new hash_pool module per ADR-013: spawn(plugins, cache, msg_tx, cancel_token) -> HashPoolHandle, worker tasks via tokio::spawn_blocking, bounded mpsc<HashJob> queue, AtomicU64 progress counters, 250ms throttle task posting Msg::HashProgressTick. Workers compute SHA256 via existing Sha2Hasher and call cache.get_or_compute. Pool size = min(num_cpus, 4). Cancellation via tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken with 200ms join timeout on shutdown.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Devon reclaims disk by unifying a duplicated model from the main view
quality_gates: tokio-util added to modeltap-app Cargo.toml only
modeltap-core has no new tokio dependency (architecture-lint test)
steps.implementation_notes: JUSTIFICATION FOR >5 files: this is a single cohesive new module split into idiomatic submodules (queue/worker/throttle/handle). Per ADR-013: SHA256 is CPU-bound -> spawn_blocking is correct primitive. JoinSet for worker tasks. On panic, surface via JoinError; failed file's row stays Pending with optional ! decorator. File-changed-mid-hash: cache key (path, mtime, size) at job-start time; next launch re-hashes. Worker concurrency cap is essential — see ADR-013 alternative B rejection.

steps.name: Wire hash_pool into composition root (post first paint, clean shutdown)
steps.description: From headless.rs and interactive.rs, after first paint completes call hash_pool::spawn(...) with discovered models. Drain Msg::Hash* from the existing event channel (no new channel). On Msg::Quit, signal cancellation token and await join with 200ms timeout. Populate HashPoolState.total at spawn time.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Devon reclaims disk by unifying a duplicated model from the main view
steps.implementation_notes: First paint MUST complete before hash pool spawn (NFR-1 / AC-U1.1). Reuse existing mpsc::UnboundedSender<Msg> — no second integration point. interactive.rs and headless.rs share the same shutdown idiom. Quit handler: signal_cancel() then join_set.join_next() with 200ms deadline.

steps.name: Extend headless script tokenizer with <hash-complete> sentinel
steps.description: One-line tokenizer addition: the headless script grammar gets a new <hash-complete> token that blocks the script driver until HashPoolState.is_complete() is true. Required for deterministic acceptance-test sync without sleep-based polling. NOT a new env-var seam.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Devon reclaims disk by unifying a duplicated model from the main view
steps.implementation_notes: Per walking-skeleton.md checklist line 81-85: this is a one-line tokenizer addition, NOT a new env var. Token blocks script execution until is_complete() returns true. Add to existing tokenizer's match statement. Used by walking-skeleton scenario between 'When background hashing completes' and the next step.

steps.name: Route u-keypress from main view to Msg::UnifyHighlighted dispatch
steps.description: In keymap::dispatch, route u from main view (currently a no-op) to Msg::UnifyHighlighted. The update handler dispatches based on the highlighted row's DedupGlyph: '=' opens dialog with mates pre-populated via core::logic::canonical_selector + plan::build_plan; '#' opens informational dialog; '-'/'?'/'~' shows status hint without opening dialog. Existing u-from-Detail path UNTOUCHED.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Pressing "u" on a "=" row opens the dialog with mates pre-populated
quality_gates: v1 us_18_unify_from_detail acceptance test continues to pass
steps.implementation_notes: Reuses existing Msg::OpenUnifyDialog(plan) — DESIGN added a main-view u-keypress producer only. Pre-population calls existing canonical_selector::select_canonical and plan::build_plan with highlighted row's mates. Status-line hints for -/?/~ are pure render via update handler returning a transient AppState.status_line message.

steps.name: Implement actions::reclassify::reclassify_after_unify in modeltap-app
steps.description: New small module actions::reclassify with pure function reclassify_after_unify(state, unify_outcome) -> AppState' that recomputes affected rows' DedupGlyphs by calling core::logic::dedup::compute_dedup_glyph and updates dedup_summary aggregates. Triggered by Msg::UnifyApplied after actions::unify::run completes. Sets summary_delta with previous dedup_able_bytes and 5s expiry.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Successful full unify flips glyph "=" to "#" and updates the summary bar
quality_gates: 200ms re-classification budget verified by timing assertion
steps.implementation_notes: Lives in modeltap-app (not core) because it consumes UnifyOutcome from the orchestrator; the actual recomputation calls core pure functions. Full-pass reclassification acceptable for v1. Partial-success path: glyph stays =, Unified count does NOT increment, dedup_able decreases by successful targets only. AC-U6.5 (transient delta + 5s collapse) is wired here via summary_delta field; SummaryDeltaExpired msg arrives via tokio sleep timer.

steps.name: Unignore us_u1_walking_skeleton — make it green
steps.description: Remove #[ignore] from us_u1_walking_skeleton::devon_reclaims_disk_by_unifying_a_duplicated_model_from_the_main_view. The scenario should pass on the back of all foundational infrastructure built in 01-01..01-11. If it fails, fix forward — do not weaken the test. Run full v1 regression suite to confirm zero regressions.

quality_gates: every v1 acceptance test (us_01..us_20, us_05b, us_atomic_chat_discovery) continues to pass

If it fails, the failure points to a gap in earlier steps — fix forward, do not weaken the assertion. Per walking-skeleton.md checklist: production code, test green, no regression, no new env-var seam.

phases.description: Render the new synthetic left-pane slot per ADR-014, the right-pane filtered view, the per-row format, and the footer aggregates. Slot count badge agrees with summary-bar Unified count and right-pane row count (AC-CONS-2).

steps.name: Implement collect_unified_rows pure function in modeltap-core
steps.description: Add core::logic::dedup::collect_unified_rows(inventory) -> Vec<UnifiedRow>. Each row carries (model_id, display_label, size_bytes, tools_sharing, saves_bytes) where saves_bytes = (tools_sharing.len() - 1) * size_bytes. Single source of truth for the All-Unified right-pane view and footer aggregates.

quality_gates: saves_bytes formula verified for N=2, 3, 4 tools

steps.name: Render [All Unified] slot in left pane and filtered right pane
steps.description: Extend render::left_pane to render LeftPaneSlot::Synthetic(SyntheticSlot::AllUnified) with the '[All Unified] (N)' label below real tool slots. Add render::all_unified module for the right-pane filtered view: list collect_unified_rows output with name + size + N tools + saves columns, plus footer 'Unified: N models | Total reclaimed by unification: X.Y GB'.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: The "[All Unified]" slot appears below the real tool slots in the left pane
quality_gates: AC-CONS-2 invariant holds (badge == summary-bar count == row count)

Badge shows '(?)' while hashing in progress (US-U8 will refine empty-state copy in Phase 06). Slot is ALWAYS visible per design decision (discoverability over conditional hiding).

steps.name: Unignore US-U7 four acceptance tests
steps.description: Remove #[ignore] from the four us_u7_all_unified_pseudo_slot test functions. Should pass on the back of 04-01 (collect_unified_rows) and 04-02 (renderers). Verify cross-artifact consistency invariant AC-CONS-2.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: "[All Unified]" badge, summary-bar count, and right-pane row count all agree

phases.name: Phase 05 — Post-unify reactivity full coverage (US-U6)
phases.description: Finalize the post-unify update path: full-success glyph flip + summary update, transient (was X) delta with 5s collapse, partial-success glyph stays = with non-incremented Unified count. Walking skeleton already exercised the full-success happy path; this phase covers AC-U6.5 (transient delta) and AC-U6.3/AC-U6.6 (partial success).

steps.name: Implement transient (was X GB) summary delta with 5s expiry timer
steps.description: On Msg::UnifyApplied success, set AppState.summary_delta = Some(SummaryDelta { previous_dedup_able_bytes, expires_at: now + 5s }). Render::summary_bar shows '<new> (was <previous>)' while delta is Some and not expired. Spawn a tokio::time::sleep(5s) -> Msg::SummaryDeltaExpired that clears the field. Pure update on expire.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Summary bar shows transient "(was X)" delta then collapses after five seconds
quality_gates: 5s timer is cancellable (no leak on quit)
steps.implementation_notes: Timer task spawned in composition root; sends Msg::SummaryDeltaExpired through existing event channel. On Msg::Quit, the cancellation token fires; timer task aborts cleanly. Render reads Instant::now() vs expires_at to gate delta display (avoids race with msg arrival).

steps.name: Implement partial-success path in reclassify_after_unify
steps.description: When UnifyOutcome contains some failed targets, reclassify_after_unify must: keep the affected row's glyph as = (NOT flip to #), NOT increment dedup_summary.unified_count, decrease dedup_able_bytes ONLY by the bytes of successful targets (not all targets). The glyph derivation happens naturally because partial-success means at least one tool still has its own copy on a separate inode.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Partial-success unify leaves the row glyph as "="
steps.implementation_notes: UnifyOutcome carries per-target results. compute_dedup_glyph naturally returns DedupAble (=) when ≥2 separate inodes still hold the same hash — partial success means one inode collapsed but another remains separate. Test fixture must inject a permission-denied error on one target only.

steps.name: Unignore US-U6 three tests (full unify / transient delta / partial)
steps.description: Remove #[ignore] from the three us_u6_post_unify_no_restart test functions. Should pass on the back of 01-11 (reclassify) + 05-01 (transient delta) + 05-02 (partial-success). Verify AC-U6.7 (no-restart) by asserting the test does not call any process restart helper.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Successful full unify flips glyph "=" to "#" and updates the summary bar
quality_gates: no process-restart calls in test bodies
steps.implementation_notes: If 200ms reclassification budget (AC-U6.1) is missed, profile the reclassify_after_unify call — full-pass over inventory should be sub-millisecond for typical sizes; the budget is generous. If failing, scope the reclassification to affected dedup-keys only.

phases.name: Phase 06 — P2 Polish (US-U8 + US-U9 + US-U10)
phases.description: Polish release: All Unified empty-state guidance, Detail-screen inode proof, partial-success toast with retry. All P2 stories are @skip in Gherkin per Luna's prioritization; Rust scaffolds are added at the start of this phase.

steps.name: Implement [All Unified] empty-state guidance (US-U8)
steps.description: Extend render::all_unified to show onboarding text when collect_unified_rows returns empty AND hashing is complete: 'No models are unified yet. Navigate to a tool, find a row marked "=", and press [u] to unify it.' When hashing is in progress and count is unknown, show a different message: 'Hashing in progress. Unified models will appear here as soon as hashing completes.' Add Rust scaffolds for the two @skip Gherkin scenarios.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Empty-state guidance is shown when no models are unified yet
steps.implementation_notes: P2 story — pure rendering, no core logic changes. Two states: hashing-in-progress vs truly-empty. Read AppState.hash_state.is_complete() to disambiguate. Scaffold the new us_u8 acceptance test file under tests/acceptance/.

steps.name: Implement Detail-screen inode display (US-U9)
steps.description: Extend the existing Detail screen renderer: for # models show the shared inode number and group all paths under it; for = models group paths by inode (one group per separate copy). Footer offers [d] delete_one and [u] unify (existing handlers). Handle missing-inode case with informational text 'inode: <not available on this filesystem>'. Add Rust scaffold for the three @skip Gherkin scenarios.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Detail for a "#" model shows the shared inode and grouped paths
steps.implementation_notes: P2 story — Tool trait already exposes path metadata; inode is read via std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt::ino(). On filesystems where stat doesn't return useful inode info, display the missing-inode informational text without crash. Scaffold us_u9 acceptance test file.

steps.name: Implement partial-success toast with retry-failed-only (US-U10)
steps.description: Replace the v1 non-specific success toast with a per-target outcome toast: 'Unified <model> into <K> of <N>' with per-target lines showing OK/FAIL+reason+bytes, total reclaim, [r] Retry-failed-only / [Enter] Continue. Pressing [r] re-runs actions::unify::run with a plan filtered to only the failed targets. Total-failure case: 'Unified into 0 of N. Reclaimed 0 GB.' Add Rust scaffold for the three @skip Gherkin scenarios.
steps.acceptance_test_scenario: Partial-success toast lists each target's outcome inline
quality_gates: retry-failed-only does not re-touch successful targets
steps.implementation_notes: P2 story — reuses existing JSONL events from actions::unify::run; per-target events already exist in v1. Toast is a TUI rendering concern. Retry path: filter the original plan to failed targets only and re-invoke actions::unify::run. Successful targets stay untouched. Scaffold us_u10 acceptance test file.
